definition: mostly; to a great degree
sentence: The success of the show was {largely} due to its music.
translation: Успех шоу был во многом обязан его музыке.

definition: completely, or in a way that could not be better
sentence: The new dress fits her {perfectly}, as if made for her.
translation: Новое платье сидит на ней идеально, словно сшито для неё.

definition: connected with what is being discussed or done
sentence: Please bring any {relevant} documents to the meeting.
translation: Пожалуйста, принесите на встречу все относящиеся к делу документы.

definition: not able to do something
sentence: She was {unable} to come because of her work.
translation: Она не смогла прийти из-за работы.

definition: a feeling of happiness or enjoyment
sentence: Reading in the garden is her greatest {pleasure}.
translation: Чтение в саду — её главное удовольствие.

definition: a person who is second in command and acts when the boss is away
sentence: The {deputy} ran the office while the manager was abroad.
translation: Заместитель руководил офисом, пока начальник был за границей.

definition: a person who agrees with and helps a team, party or idea
sentence: Every {supporter} of the club got a free scarf.
translation: Каждый болельщик клуба получил бесплатный шарф.

definition: to join or fix one thing to another
sentence: Don't forget to {attach} the photos to the email.
translation: Не забудь прикрепить фотографии к письму.

definition: to achieve what you were trying to do
sentence: If you practice every day, you will {succeed}.
translation: Если будешь заниматься каждый день, ты добьёшься успеха.

definition: having or showing new and original ideas
sentence: She is a {creative} cook who never uses a recipe.
translation: Она изобретательный повар и никогда не пользуется рецептами.

definition: films, music, games and other things that amuse people
sentence: There is live {entertainment} in the hotel every evening.
translation: В отеле каждый вечер живые развлечения.

definition: a dark shape made when something blocks the light
sentence: The tree cast a long {shadow} across the lawn.
translation: Дерево отбрасывало длинную тень на лужайку.

definition: a long, narrow piece of something
sentence: Cut the paper into a thin {strip}.
translation: Отрежь от бумаги тонкую полоску.

definition: a long, thin piece of metal, often used to carry electricity
sentence: A loose {wire} caused the lamp to stop working.
translation: Из-за отошедшего провода лампа перестала работать.

definition: sound or pictures stored so they can be played again
sentence: I have a {recording} of my grandfather singing in 1960.
translation: У меня есть запись, как дедушка поёт в 1960 году.

definition: the quality of a sound or voice that shows a feeling
sentence: I did not like the angry {tone} of his email.
translation: Мне не понравился сердитый тон его письма.

definition: one of the large areas into which some countries are divided
sentence: Quebec is the largest {province} in Canada.
translation: Квебек — самая большая провинция Канады.

definition: a punishment for breaking a rule, or a free kick in sport
sentence: There is a heavy {penalty} for parking here.
translation: За парковку здесь большой штраф.

definition: all of space and everything in it
sentence: Scientists still argue about how the {universe} began.
translation: Учёные до сих пор спорят о том, как возникла Вселенная.

definition: a person honored by the church for a holy life, or a very good person
sentence: The church is named after a {saint} who lived here long ago.
translation: Церковь названа в честь святого, который жил здесь давным-давно.

definition: an area of a town and the people who live there
sentence: We moved to a quiet {neighborhood} with lots of trees.
translation: Мы переехали в тихий район с множеством деревьев.

definition: a thick piece of wood cut from a tree, or a written record of events
sentence: Put another {log} on the fire before it goes out.
translation: Подбрось ещё одно полено в огонь, пока он не погас.

definition: a computer that stores data and sends it to other computers
sentence: The website is down because the {server} crashed.
translation: Сайт не работает, потому что сервер упал.

definition: the first public appearance of a performer or player
sentence: The young striker scored on his {debut} for the national team.
translation: Молодой нападающий забил в своём дебюте за сборную.

definition: a very small piece of silicon with electronic circuits, or a small piece broken off
sentence: The new phone has a faster {chip} inside.
translation: В новом телефоне более быстрый чип.

definition: an arrangement to meet someone at a fixed time, such as a doctor
sentence: I have a dentist's {appointment} at three o'clock.
translation: У меня приём у стоматолога в три часа.

definition: providing education, or relating to it
sentence: The museum runs {educational} tours for school groups.
translation: Музей проводит образовательные экскурсии для школьных групп.

definition: more than anything else; mostly
sentence: The guests were {mainly} friends from work.
translation: Гости были в основном друзьями с работы.

definition: a person trained to care for sick or injured people, usually in a hospital
sentence: The {nurse} checked my temperature every two hours.
translation: Медсестра проверяла мою температуру каждые два часа.

definition: to leave a person, place or thing and never return to it
sentence: I had to {abandon} my car in the snow and walk home.
translation: Мне пришлось бросить машину в снегу и идти домой пешком.

definition: the act of making something new, or the thing that is made
sentence: The {creation} of a new park took five years.
translation: Создание нового парка заняло пять лет.

definition: a toothed wheel in a machine that controls speed, or equipment for an activity
sentence: Change to a lower {gear} before the hill.
translation: Переключись на пониженную передачу перед подъёмом.

definition: unable to see
sentence: The {blind} man crossed the street with his guide dog.
translation: Слепой мужчина перешёл улицу со своей собакой-поводырём.

definition: a large piece of thin cloth for a bed, or a flat piece of paper
sentence: She put a clean {sheet} on the bed for the guest.
translation: Она постелила гостю чистую простыню.

definition: a person who sings, especially as a job
sentence: The {singer} thanked the crowd after the last song.
translation: Певица поблагодарила зрителей после последней песни.

definition: to decide something after thinking about it, or to end something
sentence: After the tests, the doctors could {conclude} that she was healthy.
translation: После анализов врачи смогли сделать вывод, что она здорова.

definition: the words you say when you speak to God
sentence: The family said a short {prayer} before dinner.
translation: Семья произнесла короткую молитву перед ужином.

definition: a painful feeling because you did something wrong, or a sad situation
sentence: He hung his head in {shame} after the lie was discovered.
translation: Он опустил голову от стыда, когда ложь раскрылась.

definition: to go up something using your hands and feet, or to rise
sentence: The children love to {climb} the old apple tree.
translation: Дети обожают лазить по старой яблоне.

definition: a room with a bath or shower, and usually a toilet
sentence: The {bathroom} is at the end of the hall on the left.
translation: Ванная в конце коридора слева.

definition: a school or college for special training, or a society of experts
sentence: He trained at the police {academy} for six months.
translation: Он полгода учился в полицейской академии.

definition: an old story that may not be true, or a very famous person
sentence: According to {legend}, a dragon once lived in the cave.
translation: По легенде, в пещере когда-то жил дракон.

definition: a person who is kept in prison
sentence: The {prisoner} was released after serving five years.
translation: Заключённого освободили после пяти лет срока.

definition: the process of getting better after illness, or of getting something back
sentence: Her {recovery} from the operation took two months.
translation: Её восстановление после операции заняло два месяца.

definition: a shoe that covers the foot and part of the leg
sentence: My left {boot} lets in water when it rains.
translation: Мой левый ботинок пропускает воду, когда идёт дождь.

definition: to stop being visible, or to go somewhere that cannot be found
sentence: The sun began to {disappear} behind the hills.
translation: Солнце стало исчезать за холмами.

definition: an object used for making music, or a tool for careful work
sentence: The piano is the only {instrument} she can play.
translation: Пианино — единственный инструмент, на котором она умеет играть.

definition: a piece of glass in which you can see yourself
sentence: She looked in the {mirror} and fixed her hair.
translation: Она посмотрела в зеркало и поправила волосы.

definition: an official agreement that ends an argument, or a place where people live
sentence: The two companies reached a {settlement} before the trial.
translation: Две компании достигли соглашения до суда.

definition: to look at something carefully to learn about it
sentence: The doctor will {examine} your knee and take an X-ray.
translation: Врач осмотрит ваше колено и сделает рентген.

definition: to depend on someone or something
sentence: Farmers {rely} on rain in the spring.
translation: Фермеры полагаются на весенние дожди.

definition: to make someone a little angry
sentence: Loud music late at night will {annoy} the neighbors.
translation: Громкая музыка поздно вечером разозлит соседей.

definition: a strong feeling such as love, anger or fear
sentence: His voice shook with {emotion} as he thanked them.
translation: Его голос дрожал от волнения, когда он благодарил их.

definition: to one side, or out of the way
sentence: She stepped {aside} to let the nurse pass.
translation: Она отошла в сторону, чтобы пропустить медсестру.

definition: help given to someone
sentence: Call this number if you need {assistance} with the form.
translation: Позвоните по этому номеру, если вам нужна помощь с формой.

definition: giving attention to what you do so that you avoid harm or mistakes
sentence: Be {careful} with that knife; it is very sharp.
translation: Осторожно с этим ножом, он очень острый.

definition: fair and sensible, or not too much
sentence: The hotel charges a {reasonable} price for a room.
translation: Отель берёт разумную цену за номер.

definition: relating to the countryside rather than the town
sentence: Many {rural} schools have fewer than fifty pupils.
translation: Во многих сельских школах меньше пятидесяти учеников.

definition: having the usual qualities of a particular type
sentence: A {typical} working day for her starts at seven.
translation: Обычный рабочий день у неё начинается в семь.

definition: a solid food made from milk
sentence: I would like a sandwich with {cheese} and tomato.
translation: Я хотел бы сэндвич с сыром и помидором.

definition: to shine brightly for a very short time
sentence: Lightning began to {flash} over the sea.
translation: Над морем засверкали молнии.

definition: an object for children to play with
sentence: The dog chewed the baby's favorite {toy}.
translation: Собака сгрызла любимую игрушку малыша.

definition: a complete change in how a country is governed or how things are done
sentence: The {revolution} of 1917 changed Russia for ever.
translation: Революция 1917 года навсегда изменила Россию.

definition: to give someone what they want or need
sentence: A glass of water will not {satisfy} your hunger.
translation: Стакан воды не утолит твой голод.

definition: to behave as if something is true when it is not
sentence: The children like to {pretend} they are pirates.
translation: Дети любят притворяться пиратами.

definition: a company that makes goods in large numbers
sentence: The car {manufacturer} opened a new factory in Poland.
translation: Автопроизводитель открыл новый завод в Польше.

definition: to pay for an event or person in return for advertising
sentence: A local bank agreed to {sponsor} the football team.
translation: Местный банк согласился спонсировать футбольную команду.

definition: a smooth and attractive way of moving, or polite and kind behavior
sentence: The dancer moved across the stage with great {grace}.
translation: Танцовщица двигалась по сцене с большой грацией.

definition: the act of looking at two things to see how they are similar or different
sentence: In {comparison} with last year, prices have barely moved.
translation: По сравнению с прошлым годом цены почти не изменились.

definition: to rest and feel calm, or to become less tight
sentence: After work she likes to {relax} with a book.
translation: После работы она любит отдохнуть с книгой.

definition: a main road between towns or cities
sentence: Traffic on the {highway} was slow because of the snow.
translation: Движение на шоссе было медленным из-за снега.

definition: a violent attack on a person
sentence: He was arrested for {assault} after the fight in the bar.
translation: Его арестовали за нападение после драки в баре.

definition: stupid, or unable to speak
sentence: It was a {dumb} idea to leave the keys in the car.
translation: Было глупо оставить ключи в машине.

definition: to move liquid or gas by pushing it with a machine
sentence: We had to {pump} water out of the flooded cellar.
translation: Нам пришлось откачивать воду из затопленного подвала.

definition: money spent on something
sentence: The trip was a big {expense}, but worth it.
translation: Поездка была большой тратой, но она того стоила.

definition: to change something into a different form, or change your beliefs
sentence: We plan to {convert} the garage into a small flat.
translation: Мы планируем переделать гараж в маленькую квартиру.

definition: to become hard because of cold, or to stop moving suddenly
sentence: The lake will {freeze} if the cold continues.
translation: Озеро замёрзнет, если холода продолжатся.

definition: to continue doing something, or to go forward
sentence: After the break, we will {proceed} with the next question.
translation: После перерыва мы перейдём к следующему вопросу.

definition: the way something is arranged or presented
sentence: The report is available in paper or electronic {format}.
translation: Отчёт доступен в бумажном или электронном формате.

definition: a large imaginary animal with wings that breathes fire
sentence: In the story, a knight fights a {dragon} to save the town.
translation: В истории рыцарь сражается с драконом, чтобы спасти город.

definition: a curved piece of metal or plastic for hanging or catching things
sentence: Hang your coat on the {hook} behind the door.
translation: Повесь пальто на крючок за дверью.

definition: a person who uses violence against ordinary people for political aims
sentence: The {terrorist} was caught before he reached the station.
translation: Террориста поймали, прежде чем он добрался до вокзала.

definition: the inside part of something, especially a building or car
sentence: The {interior} of the church is painted blue and gold.
translation: Интерьер церкви расписан синим и золотым.

definition: thin rope used for tying things, or a line of similar things
sentence: Tie the parcel with a piece of {string}.
translation: Перевяжи посылку бечёвкой.

definition: to say that someone or something is very good
sentence: The teacher was quick to {praise} the children's drawings.
translation: Учительница не замедлила похвалить рисунки детей.

definition: a person who served in the army, or who has long experience of something
sentence: My grandfather is a {veteran} of the war in Korea.
translation: Мой дедушка — ветеран войны в Корее.

definition: fighting, especially in a war
sentence: The soldiers had never seen {combat} before that night.
translation: До той ночи солдаты никогда не участвовали в бою.

definition: a number of things of the same kind held or growing together
sentence: He bought a {bunch} of flowers for his mother.
translation: Он купил букет цветов для мамы.

definition: a large bird kept for its meat, often eaten at Christmas
sentence: We roast a {turkey} every Christmas Day.
translation: Мы каждое Рождество запекаем индейку.

definition: to act dishonestly to win or get something
sentence: Students who {cheat} in the exam will fail the course.
translation: Студенты, которые спишут на экзамене, провалят курс.

definition: freedom from control by other people or countries
sentence: The country gained its {independence} in 1991.
translation: Страна получила независимость в 1991 году.

definition: chosen or happening without any plan or pattern
sentence: The computer picks a {random} winner every week.
translation: Компьютер каждую неделю выбирает случайного победителя.

definition: a room or building where works of art are shown
sentence: The {gallery} has a new show of modern photographs.
translation: В галерее новая выставка современной фотографии.

definition: a feeling of great happiness
sentence: The news of the baby filled the house with {joy}.
translation: Весть о ребёнке наполнила дом радостью.

definition: a game in which you hit a small ball into holes with long sticks
sentence: He plays {golf} with his boss every Sunday.
translation: Он каждое воскресенье играет в гольф со своим начальником.

definition: to come together in a group, or to collect things
sentence: Family members {gather} at the farm every summer.
translation: Члены семьи собираются на ферме каждое лето.

definition: a statement that you are unhappy about something
sentence: We received a {complaint} about the noise from the kitchen.
translation: Мы получили жалобу на шум из кухни.

definition: an officer in charge of a group of soldiers or a ship
sentence: The {commander} ordered his men to stop at the river.
translation: Командир приказал своим людям остановиться у реки.

definition: to pull something heavy along the ground
sentence: The boys had to {drag} the boat across the sand.
translation: Мальчикам пришлось тащить лодку по песку.

definition: to slide by accident and fall or nearly fall
sentence: Be careful not to {slip} on the wet floor.
translation: Осторожно, не поскользнись на мокром полу.

definition: the part of a country's armed forces that fights at sea
sentence: He joined the {navy} at eighteen and sailed around the world.
translation: Он пошёл на флот в восемнадцать и обошёл весь мир.

definition: a person who lives next to you or near you
sentence: Our {neighbor} waters our plants when we are away.
translation: Наш сосед поливает наши растения, когда мы в отъезде.

definition: a large meeting of people with a shared interest, or an accepted custom
sentence: Thousands of fans came to the comic book {convention}.
translation: Тысячи фанатов приехали на фестиваль комиксов.

definition: a person or thing that kills
sentence: The police are still looking for the {killer}.
translation: Полиция всё ещё ищет убийцу.

definition: the head of a government, especially of a province or state
sentence: The {premier} promised new roads before the election.
translation: Премьер пообещал новые дороги перед выборами.

definition: a problem, or the state of being hard to do
sentence: She had {difficulty} finding the house in the dark.
translation: Ей было трудно найти дом в темноте.

definition: a person who plans how things will look, such as clothes or buildings
sentence: The {designer} showed her new dresses in Paris.
translation: Дизайнер показала свои новые платья в Париже.

definition: to cover something completely with paper or cloth
sentence: Let me {wrap} the gift before she arrives.
translation: Дай я заверну подарок до её прихода.

definition: to hurt a person or animal
sentence: He managed to {injure} his back lifting the sofa.
translation: Он умудрился повредить спину, поднимая диван.

definition: the hot gas that water becomes when it boils
sentence: {Steam} rose from the pot of soup.
translation: Пар поднимался от кастрюли с супом.

definition: the set of basic laws by which a country is governed
sentence: The {constitution} gives every citizen the right to vote.
translation: Конституция даёт каждому гражданину право голоса.

definition: a series of musical notes that make a pleasant melody
sentence: She whistled a {tune} while she worked.
translation: Она насвистывала мелодию за работой.

definition: a belief that something will happen
sentence: He arrived with the {expectation} of a warm welcome.
translation: Он приехал в ожидании тёплого приёма.

definition: a long, thin band, often sticky, used for fixing or recording
sentence: Use some {tape} to stick the poster to the wall.
translation: Используй скотч, чтобы приклеить плакат к стене.

definition: something nice that you imagine but that is unlikely to happen
sentence: His {fantasy} is to live on a boat in the Caribbean.
translation: Его мечта — жить на лодке в Карибском море.

definition: something that tells you how to do or use something
sentence: Read every {instruction} before you build the shelf.
translation: Прочитай каждую инструкцию, прежде чем собирать полку.

definition: a group of countries ruled by one ruler or government
sentence: The Roman {empire} once reached from Spain to Syria.
translation: Римская империя когда-то простиралась от Испании до Сирии.

definition: the thing that is more important than anything else
sentence: Sleep is my top {priority} this week.
translation: На этой неделе мой главный приоритет — сон.

definition: correct in every small part, with nothing wrong
sentence: Is the clock in the kitchen {accurate}? Mine says ten.
translation: Часы на кухне точные? На моих десять.

definition: wanting very much to win, or as good as or better than others
sentence: The shop keeps its prices {competitive} to attract customers.
translation: Магазин держит конкурентные цены, чтобы привлекать покупателей.

definition: usually; in the ordinary way
sentence: I {normally} get up at seven on weekdays.
translation: Я обычно встаю в семь по будням.

definition: strong disagreement, or the political parties that are not in government
sentence: The plan met strong {opposition} from local residents.
translation: План встретил сильное сопротивление местных жителей.

definition: lasting for ever or for a very long time
sentence: She finally found a {permanent} job at the hospital.
translation: Она наконец нашла постоянную работу в больнице.

definition: done by a particular person and not by someone else, or in your own opinion
sentence: The manager {personally} thanked every worker.
translation: Руководитель лично поблагодарил каждого работника.

definition: the act of keeping things somewhere until they are needed, or the space for this
sentence: We rented extra {storage} for the furniture during the move.
translation: На время переезда мы арендовали дополнительное место для хранения мебели.

definition: the system of moving people or goods from place to place
sentence: Public {transportation} in the city is cheap and fast.
translation: Общественный транспорт в городе дешёвый и быстрый.

definition: finally, after everything else has been considered
sentence: {Ultimately}, it's your decision, not mine.
translation: В конечном счёте решать тебе, а не мне.

definition: different from someone or something
sentence: It is {unlike} her to be late without calling.
translation: На неё не похоже опаздывать, не позвонив.

definition: happening or produced once a week
sentence: We have a {weekly} meeting every Monday morning.
translation: У нас еженедельное собрание каждый понедельник утром.

definition: a long, thin piece of cotton or other material used for sewing
sentence: I need a needle and some black {thread}.
translation: Мне нужна иголка и чёрная нитка.

definition: a person who fights, or a fast military plane
sentence: The old boxer was a real {fighter} who never gave up.
translation: Старый боксёр был настоящим бойцом и никогда не сдавался.

definition: all around a place
sentence: The town and the {surrounding} villages lost power in the storm.
translation: Город и окрестные деревни остались без электричества во время бури.

definition: a long container filled with water for washing your body
sentence: After the long walk, a hot {bath} felt wonderful.
translation: После долгой прогулки горячая ванна была чудесной.

definition: a group of young people or criminals who cause trouble together
sentence: A {gang} of boys broke the windows of the old school.
translation: Банда мальчишек разбила окна старой школы.

definition: an illness that makes you feel very sad for a long time
sentence: After losing his job he fell into a deep {depression}.
translation: Потеряв работу, он впал в глубокую депрессию.

definition: to mention something as an example or proof
sentence: The lawyer was able to {cite} three similar cases.
translation: Адвокат смог сослаться на три похожих дела.

definition: limited to one person or group, or expensive and for rich people
sentence: The magazine has an {exclusive} interview with the president.
translation: У журнала эксклюзивное интервью с президентом.

definition: to chase and kill wild animals, or to search hard for something
sentence: Wolves {hunt} in packs at night.
translation: Волки охотятся стаями по ночам.

definition: to move smoothly over a surface
sentence: The children {slide} down the icy hill on plastic bags.
translation: Дети съезжают с ледяной горки на пластиковых пакетах.

definition: to live in or use a place, room or seat
sentence: Someone's bag is {occupying} the only free seat.
translation: Чья-то сумка занимает единственное свободное место.

definition: to hit someone or something hard with your fist
sentence: He threatened to {punch} anyone who touched his bike.
translation: Он грозился ударить кулаком любого, кто тронет его велосипед.

definition: covered in water or another liquid; not dry
sentence: My socks are {wet} from the rain.
translation: Мои носки промокли от дождя.

definition: a relationship between two people or companies that work together
sentence: The two firms formed a {partnership} to build the bridge.
translation: Две фирмы создали партнёрство для строительства моста.

definition: certain to do something or to happen, or tied with rope
sentence: With that much talent, she is {bound} to succeed.
translation: С таким талантом она обязательно добьётся успеха.

definition: a very hard, clear precious stone used in jewelry
sentence: The ring has a small {diamond} in the middle.
translation: В кольце посередине маленький бриллиант.

definition: damage or injury
sentence: A little sun does no {harm}, but too much burns the skin.
translation: Немного солнца не вредит, но слишком много обжигает кожу.

definition: an empty space between two things, or a difference
sentence: There is a {gap} in the fence where the dog gets out.
translation: В заборе есть щель, через которую собака выбирается наружу.

definition: a part of a cell that controls what a living thing inherits from its parents
sentence: One {gene} decides whether your eyes are brown or blue.
translation: Один ген определяет, карие у тебя глаза или голубые.

definition: the business of selling goods to the public in shops
sentence: She has worked in {retail} since she left school.
translation: Она работает в розничной торговле с тех пор, как окончила школу.

definition: lasting only a short time, or using few words
sentence: We had a {brief} chat in the corridor.
translation: Мы коротко поболтали в коридоре.

definition: to keep something instead of losing or giving it away
sentence: The hotel {retains} your card details for a week.
translation: Отель хранит данные вашей карты неделю.

definition: the part of the face above the mouth used for smelling and breathing
sentence: The cold air made my {nose} run.
translation: От холодного воздуха у меня потёк нос.

definition: the process of becoming larger
sentence: The {expansion} of the airport will add a third runway.
translation: Расширение аэропорта добавит третью взлётную полосу.

definition: the joint in the middle of the leg where it bends
sentence: He hurt his {knee} playing football.
translation: Он повредил колено, играя в футбол.

definition: one of the two soft edges of the mouth
sentence: She bit her {lip} to stop herself laughing.
translation: Она прикусила губу, чтобы не рассмеяться.

definition: to go down below the surface of water, or to go down slowly
sentence: Wood floats, but a stone will {sink}.
translation: Дерево плавает, а камень утонет.

definition: a person who works a machine, or who connects telephone calls
sentence: The crane {operator} lifted the beam into place.
translation: Крановщик поднял балку на место.

definition: any person; it does not matter who
sentence: Is there {anybody} at home this afternoon?
translation: Есть кто-нибудь дома сегодня днём?

definition: a game in which two teams throw a ball through a high net
sentence: He is tall enough to play {basketball} for the school.
translation: Он достаточно высокий, чтобы играть в баскетбол за школу.

definition: the state of having a paid job
sentence: The new factory will bring {employment} to the town.
translation: Новый завод принесёт городу рабочие места.

definition: often
sentence: Trains to the city run {frequently} during the day.
translation: Поезда в город днём ходят часто.

definition: used to say what you hope will happen
sentence: {Hopefully}, the rain will stop before the match.
translation: Надеюсь, дождь прекратится до матча.

definition: the quality of being important
sentence: The teacher explained the {importance} of regular sleep.
translation: Учитель объяснил важность регулярного сна.

definition: the second of two people or things just mentioned
sentence: Of tea and coffee, I prefer the {latter}.
translation: Из чая и кофе я предпочитаю последнее.

definition: the business of making goods in factories
sentence: Most jobs in the region are in {manufacturing}.
translation: Большинство рабочих мест в регионе — в промышленности.

definition: the industry of digging coal, metal or stones out of the ground
sentence: Gold {mining} made the town rich a century ago.
translation: Добыча золота обогатила город сто лет назад.

definition: the people who work for a company or organization
sentence: All {personnel} must wear a badge inside the building.
translation: Весь персонал обязан носить бейдж внутри здания.

definition: having a baby growing inside the body
sentence: My sister is {pregnant} with her second child.
translation: Моя сестра беременна вторым ребёнком.

definition: very bad, serious or extreme
sentence: He has a {severe} allergy to nuts.
translation: У него тяжёлая аллергия на орехи.

definition: to try hard to achieve something over a long time
sentence: She decided to {pursue} a career in music after all.
translation: Она всё-таки решила строить карьеру в музыке.

definition: the good feeling when something bad stops or does not happen
sentence: It was a {relief} to hear that everyone was safe.
translation: Было облегчением услышать, что все целы.

definition: treatment for an illness or problem, often without drugs
sentence: After the accident she needed months of {therapy} to walk again.
translation: После аварии ей понадобились месяцы терапии, чтобы снова ходить.

definition: a light, artificial material that can be shaped when soft
sentence: The bottle is made of {plastic}, so it will not break.
translation: Бутылка сделана из пластика, так что она не разобьётся.

definition: a small, flat, round piece of metal used as money
sentence: He found an old {coin} in the garden.
translation: Он нашёл в саду старую монету.

definition: able to make good decisions because of knowledge and experience
sentence: It was {wise} to book the tickets early.
translation: Было разумно забронировать билеты заранее.

definition: to replace something with a newer or better version
sentence: You should {upgrade} your phone's software tonight.
translation: Тебе стоит обновить программу телефона сегодня вечером.

definition: the land and buildings of a university or college
sentence: Students can live on {campus} in their first year.
translation: Студенты могут жить в кампусе на первом курсе.

definition: covered in mud, dust or other unwanted things; not clean
sentence: Take off those {dirty} boots before you come in.
translation: Сними эти грязные ботинки, прежде чем входить.

definition: most important; main
sentence: The {principal} reason for the delay was the weather.
translation: Главной причиной задержки была погода.

definition: to make a hole in the ground with a tool or your hands
sentence: The dog likes to {dig} holes under the fence.
translation: Собака любит рыть ямы под забором.

definition: to send goods to another country to sell them
sentence: The country will {export} more wine this year.
translation: В этом году страна экспортирует больше вина.

definition: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time
sentence: Her {twin} looks exactly like her, but is much quieter.
translation: Её сестра-близнец выглядит точно так же, но гораздо тише.

definition: the daughter of a king or queen, or the wife of a prince
sentence: The {princess} waved to the crowd from the balcony.
translation: Принцесса помахала толпе с балкона.

definition: the legal end of a marriage
sentence: After the {divorce} she moved back to her home town.
translation: После развода она вернулась в родной город.

definition: a track for trains, or the system of trains and tracks
sentence: The old {railway} across the mountains is still used by tourists.
translation: Старая железная дорога через горы до сих пор используется туристами.

definition: a person who is owned by another person and must work for them without pay
sentence: The {slave} escaped and fled north to freedom.
translation: Раб сбежал и отправился на север к свободе.

definition: a group of twelve
sentence: Buy a {dozen} eggs and a loaf of bread.
translation: Купи дюжину яиц и буханку хлеба.

definition: happening all the time or staying the same
sentence: A new baby needs {constant} attention from its parents.
translation: Новорождённому нужно постоянное внимание родителей.

definition: a clear difference between two things
sentence: The {contrast} between the rich and poor parts of the city is shocking.
translation: Контраст между богатыми и бедными районами города поражает.

definition: to remove something, especially from a computer
sentence: Please {delete} the old photos to free up space.
translation: Пожалуйста, удали старые фотографии, чтобы освободить место.

definition: a person between thirteen and nineteen years old
sentence: Every {teen} in the class has a smartphone.
translation: У каждого подростка в классе есть смартфон.

definition: a change from one state or situation to another
sentence: The {transition} from school to work can be hard.
translation: Переход от школы к работе может быть трудным.

definition: the hard outer covering of an egg, nut or some animals
sentence: The crab hid inside its {shell}.
translation: Краб спрятался в свой панцирь.

definition: a person who starts a company, organization or city
sentence: The {founder} of the company still works there at eighty.
translation: Основатель компании в восемьдесят лет всё ещё работает там.

definition: to cut into something with your teeth
sentence: Be careful, the dog might {bite} you.
translation: Осторожно, собака может тебя укусить.

definition: an action that breaks a religious or moral law
sentence: In many religions, lying is a {sin}.
translation: Во многих религиях ложь — грех.

definition: extremely clever or very good, or very bright
sentence: She had a {brilliant} idea for the school play.
translation: У неё была блестящая идея для школьного спектакля.

definition: a chemical element found in coal, diamonds and all living things
sentence: Burning fuel puts more {carbon} into the air.
translation: Сжигание топлива выбрасывает в воздух больше углерода.

definition: using small electrical parts such as chips, or done by computer
sentence: The shop sells {electronic} devices like phones and cameras.
translation: Магазин продаёт электронные устройства, такие как телефоны и камеры.

definition: the state of being real or alive
sentence: Few people doubt the {existence} of climate change today.
translation: Сегодня мало кто сомневается в существовании изменения климата.

definition: a law or set of laws made by a government
sentence: New {legislation} will limit the use of plastic bags.
translation: Новое законодательство ограничит использование пластиковых пакетов.

definition: the work of keeping something in good condition
sentence: Regular {maintenance} keeps the car running smoothly.
translation: Регулярное обслуживание поддерживает машину в хорошем состоянии.

definition: not far away
sentence: We had lunch at a {nearby} cafe.
translation: Мы пообедали в кафе неподалёку.

definition: refusal to accept something, or the act of fighting against it
sentence: The new rules met with strong {resistance} from the staff.
translation: Новые правила встретили сильное сопротивление сотрудников.

definition: small white or brown grains cooked and eaten as food
sentence: We ate chicken with {rice} and vegetables.
translation: Мы ели курицу с рисом и овощами.

definition: to some degree, a little
sentence: The hotel was {somewhat} smaller than in the photos.
translation: Отель оказался несколько меньше, чем на фотографиях.

definition: used to show that you think something must be true
sentence: {Surely} you are not going out in this rain?
translation: Неужели ты собираешься выйти в такой дождь?

definition: the act of saying what is bad about someone or something
sentence: The film received a lot of {criticism} for its violence.
translation: Фильм получил много критики за жестокость.

definition: extra time allowed, or a part added to make something bigger
sentence: The teacher gave us a week's {extension} on the essay.
translation: Учитель дал нам неделю отсрочки по эссе.

definition: a complete path that electricity flows around, or a track for racing
sentence: A broken wire interrupted the {circuit} and the light went out.
translation: Оборванный провод разомкнул цепь, и свет погас.

definition: relating to seeing
sentence: The film is a {visual} feast of color and light.
translation: Фильм — визуальный пир цвета и света.

definition: to tear something quickly and roughly
sentence: She managed to {rip} her dress on a nail.
translation: Она умудрилась порвать платье о гвоздь.

definition: a chemical that can burn skin and dissolve metal, often with a sour taste
sentence: The {acid} in lemons makes them taste sour.
translation: Кислота в лимонах делает их кислыми.

definition: an illness that affects the mind or body, or a lack of order
sentence: She was treated for an eating {disorder} as a teenager.
translation: В подростковом возрасте её лечили от расстройства пищевого поведения.

definition: to put a dead body in the ground, or to hide something under the ground
sentence: The dog likes to {bury} bones in the garden.
translation: Собака любит закапывать кости в саду.

definition: something you decide after thinking, or the end of something
sentence: After the trial, the jury came to the {conclusion} that he was innocent.
translation: После процесса присяжные пришли к выводу, что он невиновен.

definition: the first part of a book or speech, or the act of presenting someone
sentence: The {introduction} to the book explains why she wrote it.
translation: Во введении к книге объясняется, почему она её написала.

definition: the act of forming something, or the way things are arranged
sentence: Clouds are the {formation} of tiny water drops in the sky.
translation: Облака образуются из крошечных капель воды в небе.

definition: the air that goes in and out of your body
sentence: Take a deep {breath} and try to relax.
translation: Сделай глубокий вдох и попробуй расслабиться.

definition: a smaller group within a larger one, often with a different race or religion
sentence: Only a {minority} of students voted in the election.
translation: Лишь меньшинство студентов проголосовало на выборах.

definition: a small flying animal that comes out at night, or a stick for hitting balls
sentence: A {bat} flew out of the cave at dusk.
translation: Летучая мышь вылетела из пещеры в сумерках.

definition: a very stupid person
sentence: Only an {idiot} would swim in the river in January.
translation: Только идиот будет плавать в реке в январе.

definition: to accept or admit that something is true
sentence: At least he {acknowledged} that it was his mistake.
translation: Он хотя бы признал, что это была его ошибка.

definition: a judgment about how good or bad something is, or a test
sentence: Students get a written {assessment} at the end of each term.
translation: В конце каждого семестра студенты получают письменную оценку.

definition: the part of the body on each side, between the waist and the leg
sentence: My grandmother broke her {hip} when she fell.
translation: Моя бабушка сломала бедро, когда упала.

definition: the final result of a process or event
sentence: Whatever the {outcome}, I'm glad we tried.
translation: Каким бы ни был результат, я рад, что мы попытались.

definition: an organization that helps people in need, or money given to such people
sentence: The {charity} gives free meals to the homeless.
translation: Благотворительная организация раздаёт бесплатную еду бездомным.

definition: something you are trying to achieve
sentence: Our main {objective} is to finish the bridge by June.
translation: Наша главная цель — закончить мост к июню.

definition: a thin pointed piece of metal that you turn to fix things together
sentence: One {screw} is missing from the back of the chair.
translation: На задней части стула не хватает одного винта.

definition: a hole through which liquid or gas escapes, or the release of secret information
sentence: There is a {leak} in the roof above the kitchen.
translation: В крыше над кухней течь.

definition: to keep something in its original state or in good condition
sentence: Salt was used to {preserve} meat before fridges existed.
translation: Соль использовали, чтобы сохранять мясо, пока не было холодильников.

definition: to change something to the opposite, or to drive backwards
sentence: The court decided to {reverse} the earlier decision.
translation: Суд решил отменить предыдущее решение.

definition: the space between two lines that meet, or a way of looking at something
sentence: The photo was taken from a strange {angle}.
translation: Фотография снята под странным углом.

definition: to build something, or to create an idea or plan
sentence: It took two years to {construct} the new stadium.
translation: Строительство нового стадиона заняло два года.

definition: not known or not familiar
sentence: The painting is by an {unknown} artist of the 1600s.
translation: Картина написана неизвестным художником XVII века.

definition: a plan or agreement about how something will happen, or the way things are placed
sentence: We have an {arrangement} to share the car on weekdays.
translation: У нас договорённость делить машину по будням.

definition: a person who is good at sport and competes in it
sentence: The young {athlete} trains six days a week.
translation: Молодой спортсмен тренируется шесть дней в неделю.

definition: to plan or organize something, or to put things in order
sentence: I will {arrange} a taxi to take you to the airport.
translation: Я организую такси, которое отвезёт вас в аэропорт.

definition: a plant like a small tree with many branches growing from the ground
sentence: A bird made its nest in the rose {bush}.
translation: Птица свила гнездо в розовом кусте.

definition: the day each year when you remember something that happened on that date
sentence: They celebrated their tenth wedding {anniversary} in Rome.
translation: Они отметили десятую годовщину свадьбы в Риме.

definition: to bring something back to its earlier good condition
sentence: They {restored} the old cinema and it looks amazing.
translation: Они отреставрировали старый кинотеатр, и он выглядит потрясающе.

definition: simple, with nothing added, or easy to understand
sentence: She wore a {plain} white shirt and jeans.
translation: На ней была простая белая рубашка и джинсы.

definition: complete and total
sentence: The room was in {absolute} silence during the exam.
translation: В комнате стояла полная тишина во время экзамена.

definition: the business of telling people about products to make them buy them
sentence: The company spends millions on {advertising} every year.
translation: Компания тратит миллионы на рекламу каждый год.

definition: an American game in which teams hit a ball with a bat and run
sentence: He collects old {baseball} cards from the 1950s.
translation: Он собирает старые бейсбольные карточки 1950-х годов.

definition: making you feel happy and interested; full of excitement
sentence: The last ten minutes of the match were really {exciting}.
translation: Последние десять минут матча были по-настоящему захватывающими.

definition: to a great degree, or with great weight
sentence: It rained {heavily} all night and the river rose.
translation: Всю ночь шёл сильный дождь, и река поднялась.

definition: in a way that is large or important enough to notice
sentence: Prices have risen {significantly} since last year.
translation: Цены значительно выросли с прошлого года.

definition: by many people, or over a large area
sentence: Her books are {widely} read in Europe.
translation: Её книги широко читают в Европе.

definition: existing or happening everywhere in the world
sentence: The company has a {worldwide} network of shops.
translation: У компании всемирная сеть магазинов.

definition: a musical instrument with six strings that you play with your fingers
sentence: He learned to play the {guitar} from videos online.
translation: Он научился играть на гитаре по видео в интернете.

definition: the front part of the body between the neck and the stomach
sentence: The doctor listened to my {chest} with a stethoscope.
translation: Врач послушал мою грудь стетоскопом.

definition: the part of a gun you pull to fire, or something that starts an event
sentence: He kept his finger away from the {trigger}.
translation: Он держал палец подальше от спускового крючка.

definition: a child of your aunt or uncle
sentence: My {cousin} from Spain is staying with us this summer.
translation: Мой двоюродный брат из Испании гостит у нас этим летом.

definition: to make something grow or improve quickly
sentence: A good night's sleep really {boosts} my mood.
translation: Хороший сон здорово поднимает мне настроение.

definition: a sign that someone has an illness
sentence: A high temperature is a common {symptom} of flu.
translation: Высокая температура — частый симптом гриппа.

definition: having a small distance between two sides, or not fat
sentence: The ice on the pond is too {thin} to walk on.
translation: Лёд на пруду слишком тонкий, чтобы по нему ходить.

definition: the time of life after you stop working because of age
sentence: My father is enjoying his {retirement} by the sea.
translation: Мой отец наслаждается пенсией у моря.

definition: a large boat or ship, or a container for liquids
sentence: The {vessel} left the port with two hundred passengers.
translation: Судно вышло из порта с двумястами пассажирами.

definition: a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country
sentence: As an {immigrant}, he had to learn the language fast.
translation: Как иммигранту, ему пришлось быстро выучить язык.

definition: a brave fighter, especially in the past
sentence: The {warrior} rode into battle with a sword and shield.
translation: Воин отправился в бой с мечом и щитом.

definition: something good that you have done with effort and skill
sentence: Finishing the marathon was her greatest {achievement}.
translation: Пробежать марафон было её величайшим достижением.

definition: a person or company that pays people to work for them
sentence: My {employer} gives every worker thirty days of holiday.
translation: Мой работодатель даёт каждому работнику тридцать дней отпуска.

definition: an idea or plan that you offer for someone to consider
sentence: Thank you for your {suggestion}; we will think about it.
translation: Спасибо за ваше предложение, мы его обдумаем.

definition: a funny film, play or show that makes people laugh
sentence: We watched a {comedy} and laughed all evening.
translation: Мы посмотрели комедию и весь вечер смеялись.

definition: extra money paid for good work, or anything extra and pleasant
sentence: Every worker got a {bonus} at the end of the year.
translation: Каждый работник получил премию в конце года.

definition: an amount of money, or the total when numbers are added together
sentence: He paid a large {sum} for the painting.
translation: Он заплатил за картину большую сумму.

definition: something you plan or mean to do
sentence: I have no {intention} of working this weekend.
translation: Я не собираюсь работать в эти выходные.

definition: to remove something completely
sentence: We {eliminated} sugar from our breakfast this month.
translation: В этом месяце мы полностью убрали сахар из завтрака.

definition: almost not at all
sentence: I could {hardly} hear her over the music.
translation: Я почти не слышал её из-за музыки.

definition: to speak in public in support of an idea or plan
sentence: She has {advocated} for shorter working weeks for years.
translation: Она уже много лет выступает за короткую рабочую неделю.

definition: a promise to do something or to stay with someone
sentence: A puppy is a big {commitment} for ten years or more.
translation: Щенок — это серьёзное обязательство на десять лет и больше.

definition: to strongly advise someone to do something
sentence: I {urge} you to book the tickets today.
translation: Я настоятельно советую тебе купить билеты сегодня.

definition: something valuable you give up to get something more important
sentence: Moving away from my family was a big {sacrifice}.
translation: Переезд далеко от семьи стал большой жертвой.

definition: to find a solution to a problem or argument
sentence: We {resolved} the issue with the bill in two minutes.
translation: Мы уладили вопрос со счётом за две минуты.

definition: extremely good, much better than usual
sentence: The service at that hotel was {outstanding}.
translation: Сервис в том отеле был выдающимся.

definition: to include something as part of a bigger whole
sentence: We {incorporated} your ideas into the final design.
translation: Мы включили ваши идеи в итоговый дизайн.

definition: the speed at which something happens or someone moves
sentence: Slow down, I can't keep up with your {pace}.
translation: Помедленнее, я не поспеваю за твоим темпом.

definition: a line or limit that shows where something ends
sentence: I need to set a {boundary} about work calls after eight.
translation: Мне нужно провести границу: никаких рабочих звонков после восьми.

definition: only just, almost not at all
sentence: I {barely} made it to the train on time.
translation: Я едва успел на поезд.

definition: extremely large in size or amount
sentence: A {vast} field of sunflowers stretched behind the house.
translation: За домом раскинулось огромное поле подсолнухов.

definition: to change something a little so it works better
sentence: Can you {adjust} the chair? It is too low for me.
translation: Можешь подкрутить кресло? Оно для меня слишком низкое.

definition: to change something completely into something different
sentence: A coat of paint {transformed} the whole room.
translation: Один слой краски полностью преобразил комнату.

definition: always behaving or happening in the same way
sentence: Her results have been {consistent} all season.
translation: Её результаты были стабильными весь сезон.
